newsitem.title: USA: Colgate-Palmolive splits stock, ups dividend.
newsitem.headline: Colgate-Palmolive splits stock, ups dividend.

text.p: Colgate-Palmolive Co. on Thursday declared a two-for-one stock split and increased its quarterly dividend to 55 cents a share from 47 cents
The maker of toothpaste, soap and other personal care and household products said its board also recommended a doubling of its authorised common stock to 1 billion shares.
The New York-based company said the stock split was not contingent on the increase in authorised shares, which will be voted on at the annual meeting May 8.
Colgate said its stock has appreciated 178 percent since its last two-for-one split on May 15, 1991.
Colgate's stock rose $2.625 to $109.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
The higher dividend, on pre-split shares, is payable May 15, for shareholders of record April 25. The stock split will be effective May 15.
